sequenceReference.note: This package opens only the repository first-child boundary that a future, separately scoped one-golden-slice / walking-skeleton package would need. It does not narrow, close or execute step 4 of the pinned sequence, and it materializes no adapter, no delivery surface and no golden-slice code of any kind.

goal: Move `adapters` and `delivery` from the repository root's forbidden first-children-of-src set to its permitted set, so a future, separately authorized one-golden-slice/walking-skeleton package has a boundary to write into, the same way `sdk` was opened by planning/gj01-src-sdk-boundary-authority.json. Introduces no adapter code, no delivery surface, no populated src/adapters or src/delivery tree, no HTTP/ASGI/Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI/Django server, no persistence or DB runtime change, no CommitReceipt or outbox/audit runtime, no app, release, deploy or private-repo change.

boundaryChange.note: This package moves exactly two names across the line, the way src/sdk moved for the generated-SDK boundary package. No first child remains forbidden by name after this package; an unclassified first child still fails closed as unknown.

userJourney.before: Kullanıcı bir CRM/HRMS formunu göndermek istese bile, gönderilen bilgiyi karşılayacak hiçbir teslimat (delivery) veya bağlayıcı (adapter) kodu yok; depoda src/adapters ve src/delivery klasörü açmak bile yasaktı.
userJourney.after: Hâlâ hiçbir form gönderilemiyor, hiçbir sunucu çalışmıyor. Tek değişen şey: gelecekte ayrı bir paket olarak onaylanacak 'bir altın dilim' (one golden slice) çalışması için depo kapısı açıldı — src/adapters ve src/delivery artık isim olarak yasak değil, ama bu paket o klasörleri hâlâ oluşturmuyor, boş bırakıyor.
userJourney.note: Kapıyı açmak, kapıdan geçmek değildir. Bu paket sadece kapıyı açar.

nextPackage.note: A future, separately scoped, single-writer one-golden-slice/walking-skeleton package may target src/adapters and src/delivery once this package is GREEN and separately approved by Codex MASTER. That package defines its own allowed files, non-goals, RED/GREEN and rollback, and this package takes no position on its shape (HTTP framework, persistence, CommitReceipt or otherwise).
preconditions: npm test and npm run check are GREEN on this package
separate Codex MASTER approval is recorded
the one-golden-slice package is scoped test-first with its own allowedFiles, non-goals, RED/GREEN and rollback

nonGoals: no src/adapters or src/delivery directory or file is created in this package
no HTTP, ASGI, Uvicorn, Hypercorn, FastAPI or Django delivery surface
no persistence or DB runtime change beyond the shared root-source-topology mirror
no CommitReceipt, outbox or audit runtime behaviour
no golden-slice or walking-skeleton implementation of any kind
no change to src/domain, src/application or src/sdk source
no app, module or release/deploy/publish path
no version bump, no README change
no readiness, MVP, buildable, releasable, deployable or production claim anywhere in this package

red.note: Before the checker, existing repository-boundary tests and the substrate mirror are updated, the new boundary-authority test and the still-unmodified existing suites expect adapters and delivery permitted while the checker (and its mirrors) still forbid them by name, so the targeted run fails on the boundary-authority rows.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: the boundary change, the flags block or the non-goals set drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert planning/gj01-v12-src-adapters-delivery-boundary-authority.json, tests/kernel-one-golden-slice-boundary-authority.test.mjs, tools/check-repository-boundary.mjs, tests/repository-boundary.test.mjs, db/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.json, tests/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.test.mjs and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one seven-file shard.
